poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Hold the bar at shoulder width with your palms down and wrists straight.

poses.label: Curl
poses.description: Bend your elbows to lift the bar while keeping your upper arms beside your torso.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Finish the curl with palms down and wrists in line with your forearms.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower slowly until your arms are long again.

checks: Compared grip, setup, range, and return with the catalog cue and reference.
Validated contacts, framing, and limb lengths across interpolated poses.
limitations: Palm orientation is conveyed by the cue and grip metadata. The renderer does not draw individual finger or wrist orientation.
Phone playback and admin review are pending.
